propositions: BindingStore.unbind() conditionally removes reverse index entries only when the forward entry contains a jira_key, leaving orphaned keys when the forward entry lacks jira_key or is already removed
Reverse index entries orphaned by unbind() cannot be cleaned up through any supported public API surface, causing store_integrity audit to report permanent non-zero orphan counts
Concurrent merge conflicts resolving bindings.json as merge=ours can drop forward entries wholesale without corresponding reverse index cleanup, permanently stranding orphaned reverse keys

unbind() must unconditionally remove reverse index entries by sweeping for any reverse[K] == local_id after popping the forward entry, making cleanup self-contained and independent of forward entry contents

rebar bridge fsck --repair flag with prune_orphan_reverse_bindings() verb must delete orphaned reverse keys only when all four guards pass: only reverse_missing_forward findings present, orphan key not in bindings-retired.json, no competing forward binding exists, and forward map unchanged post-deletion
